newsitem.title: USA: Ramco-Gershenson buys Florida retail center.
newsitem.headline: Ramco-Gershenson buys Florida retail center.

text.p: Ramco-Gershenson Properties Trust said Wednesday it acquired the Shoppes of Lakeland, a community shopping center in Lakeland, Fla., for $12.7 million.
The 248,792-square-foot center is located on the east side of U.S. Highway 98, directly across from Lakeland Square, the only regional mall in the area.
Ramco-Gershenson President Dennis Gershenson said the center offers growth potential, and average rents paid by smaller tenants are below current market rates.
"On an annualized basis, before debt service, we expect this asset to add approximately $1.46 million to the company's current net operating income."

Ramco-Gershenson Properties Trust, a real estate investment trust, has a portfolio of 31 shopping centers with over 6.5 million square feet of gross leaseable area, located in Michigan, Ohio, Florida, New York, New Jersey, Maryland and Wisconsin.
